physical_atom.path_transfer_identity: R e_j=(-1)^j e_(41-j), hence Q=R D is the unsigned reversal permutation
physical_atom.zero_coupling_edges: one translated closing edge per atom; all other couplings are strictly positive
physical_atom.literature: Christandl, Datta, Ekert, Landahl, Phys. Rev. Lett. 92, 187902 (2004), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.92.187902

full_distribution.derivation: q_M is uniform on the 2^21 transversals of M. M_t union M_s has gcd(21,t-s) alternating cycles, hence 2^gcd common transversals. Therefore sum_S q(S)^2=2^-42*(1/21)*sum_r 2^gcd(21,r)=99880/2^42.

scope: The 21 path-transfer atoms are in the real-coupling cycle family when zero couplings are allowed. Their mixture is pair-level optimal among bipartite perfect-matching mixtures but is not the balanced-slice target: it has zero same-parity pair moments and -1/21 cross-parity pair moments, rather than -1/41 for every pair. The chi-square and TV bounds are for this explicit program-label law, not Choi or diamond distance. This does not settle the convex hull of non-permutation cycle exponentials.
